title: What a bond line means
statement:
In a Lewis drawing, what does one line connecting two atoms represent?

[_]{a}

explanations: A single line stands for two shared electrons.
An ordinary line denotes a pair.
A line belongs to a bond between atoms.
Two lines would represent the double bond.

hints: One line replaces a pair of dots.
For an octet, each atom counts both shared electrons.
solution: Look at valence electron bookkeeping. One line replaces a pair of dots. For an octet, each atom counts both shared electrons. A single line stands for two shared electrons.
